site_tagline: Decks and meta stats from real ranked SPAM matches.
footer_disclaimer: Unofficial fan site, not affiliated with Ticroco. SPAM content belongs to Ticroco.
home_app_text: It watches your SPAM folder and uploads each ranked match for you.
stats_intro: The meta of each version, from ranked matches between players. Mirror matches and disputed matches do not count.
new_deck_text: Pick 4 cards and 1 talent for each card. A new deck is a draft. Publish it from its page.
delete_deck_text: This deletes the deck, its votes and its comments. You cannot undo this action.
login_to_comment: Log in with Steam to comment.
hint_name: Enter a name of 1 to 60 characters.
picker_full: The deck has 4 cards. Remove or replace a card to change it.
credits_intro: The card illustrations of SPAM belong to Ticroco and to their artists. SPAM.live is an unofficial fan site, not affiliated with Ticroco.
import_intro: The site reads the files that SPAM writes on your disk. Your ranked matches go into the public stats, and your game decks become private drafts.
import_folder_hidden: On Windows, the AppData folder is hidden. In the folder dialog, paste the path in the address bar, then press Enter.
import_sent_text: Your browser asks you to confirm the upload of the folder. The site reads the folder in your browser and sends only:
import_sent_replays: the match list (index.json) and the replay files (.srpl) of the server api.crocodyle.fr,
import_sent_logs: the lines with your decks ("Sending decks to server") in Player.log and Player-prev.log.
import_sent_nothing_else: It sends no other file and no other log line.
import_login: Log in with Steam to import your matches.
import_needs_js: The import needs JavaScript. Turn on JavaScript, then load this page again.
import_pick_help: Select the Spam folder itself, not a folder in it.
import_no_replays: No match file found. The selected folder must contain {path}. Select the Spam folder at the path above.
import_ready: SPAM accounts: {accounts} · Replay files: {replays} · Deck lines: {decks}
import_no_deck_lines: No deck line in the logs.
import_keep_10: SPAM keeps only your last 10 matches. Import again before you play 10 new matches, or the older matches are lost.
import_app: Install the desktop app. It sends each new match automatically.
import_network_error: The request failed. Check your connection, then try again.
me_not_linked: Not linked. Your first import links it.
devices_text: A linked app can send your matches. Revoke an app that you do not use.
delete_account_deleted: This deletes your account and its data: decks, comments, votes, reports, uploads, replays, sessions and linked apps.
delete_account_kept: The match rows stay in the stats, without any link to you. If you are banned, your SteamID stays in the ban list.
link_text: Enter the code that the desktop app shows.
link_login: Log in with Steam to link the app.
link_done: The desktop app is now linked. You can close this page.
admin_ban_text: The user can no longer write. Their sessions and linked apps are deleted. Their SteamID goes into the ban list.
admin_users_text: Ban, unban or unlink the SPAM account of a user by ID. Each report shows the ID of the author.
privacy_intro: This page tells you which data the site keeps about you, why, for how long, and how to delete it.
privacy_who_text: SPAM.live is an unofficial fan site made by players. It is not affiliated with Ticroco, the studio that makes SPAM.
privacy_store_steam: Your SteamID, your Steam name and the address of your Steam avatar. Steam gives them when you log in.
privacy_store_account: Your SPAM AccountId (the ID of your game account), from your first import.
privacy_store_matches: Match data: the cards of both players, the winner, the game mode, the game version, the start and end times, and your stars.
privacy_store_replays: The replay files (.srpl). They contain the in-game name of your opponent. We keep them 12 months and never show them in public.
privacy_store_content: Your decks, guides, comments, votes and reports.
privacy_store_devices: The desktop apps that you link to your account.
privacy_not_store_opponent: The ID and the name of your opponent: they are not in the database.
privacy_not_store_logs: The hardware data in the game logs. Your browser sends only the deck lines.
privacy_not_store_files: The other files of the game folder. Your browser does not send them.
privacy_why_text: We use the matches to make public meta stats. The stats show only totals, never your name. Your decks and guides let you share your strategies with other players.
privacy_retention_rest: All other data: until you delete your account.
privacy_delete_text: Use the button "Delete my account" on this page:
privacy_delete_all: This deletes your account and all its data at once.
privacy_delete_matches: The match rows stay in the stats, but without any link to you.
privacy_delete_ban: If you are banned, your SteamID stays in a ban list, so that you cannot come back with a new account.
privacy_cookies_text: The site uses one session cookie to keep you logged in, and one short cookie during the Steam login. It uses no tracking or advertising cookie.
home_subtitle: The companion app records each ranked match and turns it into stats you can read at a glance.
glossary_text: The keywords, effects, abilities, talents and Tox of the game, with the cards that use them.
palette_placeholder: Search cards, decks and the glossary
shortcut_search: Go to the search field of the page
download_intro: The app watches your SPAM folder and uploads each new ranked match automatically.
download_windows_note: The installer is not signed, so Windows SmartScreen can show a warning. Click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.
download_linux_note: Make the file executable before you start it:
download_error: Release info is not available right now
download_about: I play SPAM and I build SPAM.live in my free time. I want one place to share decks and to read the meta from real ranked matches. The code is open source: send your ideas and bug reports on GitHub.
download_step_link: Link it to your SPAM.live account.
download_step_play: Play ranked matches. The app uploads them.
analytics_no_versions: No app in the last 7 days.
privacy_store_presence: Each open tab of the site sends a random ID every 30 seconds. The ID lives only in this tab (sessionStorage) and 90 seconds in the server memory. It has no link to your account. We keep only totals per hour.
privacy_store_app_presence: The desktop app tells the server when it opens, every 10 minutes while it runs, and when it closes, with its version number.
privacy_store_upload_source: We record if a match upload came from the website or from the desktop app.
pace_text: The length of the matches in turns, and the cards whose decks win more often in short or in long matches.
history_text: The play share and the win rate of each element in the last full week, the change against the week before, and up to the last 12 full weeks. The play share is the part of the card slots with the element.
overview_text: The ranked matches of this version, the players who uploaded them and the different decks. The chart shows the matches of the last 30 days.
overview_chart_label: Bar chart of the ranked matches per day for the last 30 days, in UTC.
metamap_text: Each dot is a card: how often decks play it, and how often these decks win. A card with few games can have an extreme win rate.
metamap_label: Chart of the cards: play rate from left to right, win rate from bottom to top.
metamap_list: The same values are in the card list.
counters_text: Choose 1 to 4 cards. The list shows the cards that win most often against decks with all of them.
counters_empty: Choose 1 or more cards to see what beats them.

match.countPlural=one: {count} game against decks with these cards
match.countPlural=*: {count} games against decks with these cards

counters_none: No game against these cards yet.
duos_text: 2 cards in the same deck, whatever the 2 other cards are. The order uses a reliable score (the lower bound of the Wilson interval), as for decks. The colored value compares the duo with the mean win rate of its 2 cards.
duos_synergy_up: Synergy: {value} points more than the mean win rate of the 2 cards alone.
duos_synergy_down: Synergy: {value} points less than the mean win rate of the 2 cards alone.
duos_synergy_none: Synergy: the same as the mean win rate of the 2 cards alone.
metamap_zoom_hint: Ctrl + scroll or pinch to zoom, drag to move
pace_median_all: Each version uses its own median turn count.
pace_short_split_all: At most the median of each version
pace_long_split_all: More than the median of each version
pace_info: The split is the median turn count of each version. The value is the win rate of the decks with the card in each part. The order uses the adjusted win rate, which moves toward 50 % with few games, so a card with few games comes lower. The 4 cards of a popular deck share the same games, so cards of 1 deck can show together.
history_caption: Play share and win rate of each element in the last full week, with the change against the week before
card_matchups_text: Win rate of this card against each opposing card, in the selected version.
deck_matchups_text: Win rate of this deck against each opposing card, in version {version}.
tiers_text: Tiers compare the adjusted win rate of the cards. Few games move it toward 50 %.
tiers_banner: The cards from S to D, by adjusted win rate in the latest version.
feedback_intro: Report a bug or share an idea with the SPAM.live team.
feedback_login: Log in with Steam to send feedback
feedback_placeholder_bug: What did you do, what did you expect, and what happened?
feedback_placeholder_idea: What do you want on the site, and why?
feedback_note: The page URL, the site version and your browser are always sent.
feedback_thanks: Thank you. We received your feedback.
feedback_limit: The limit is 5 feedbacks in 24 hours. Try again later.
feedback_error: The feedback was not sent. Try again.
annotate_hint: Draw, frame or blur a zone. Blur hides data that the automatic mask did not hide.
privacy_store_feedback: Your feedback: the text, the page, the site version, your browser and the screenshot. We keep them and publish them in a public GitHub issue, without your name.
